pages.text: By default, days-to-mature is $(bold)derived automatically$() from the Serene Seasons config:$(li)one season = 3 sub-seasons x sub-season length$(li)crops spanning $(bold)2 or more seasons$() (including year-round) mature once per season$(li)crops limited to $(bold)one season$() mature twice per season$(br2)You can override this per crop with $(thing)/seedseasons growth <days>$().

pages.title: Derivation example
pages.text: With the default sub-season length of 8 days, one season is 24 days.$(br2)A year-round crop takes 24 days to mature. A single-season crop takes 12 days.$(br2)If you change the sub-season length in Serene Seasons, unlisted crops follow automatically; listed ones need manual adjustment.
